result.empty: Choose a state, a district and a scheme to see a result.

warning.survey_estimate: Based on a household survey (NFHS), not official sign-up counts. District values carry sampling error and cover more than this scheme alone.
warning.low_confidence: The range is wider than 30 percentage points. Treat this result with caution.
warning.new_policy: This is a new policy, far from any real scheme. The range is wider.
warning.out_of_range: Beyond what real schemes do: a setting is outside the values of real schemes, so the model is less certain.
warning.partial_data: Some data for this state is missing or comes from a state average.
